name: Wandeng Zhaoye
source:
Captain of the Arborangers, one of the administrators of Inlixaland. High-ranking yet approachable. It is said that she handles most of the daily affairs inside the Main Beacon.

[spoiler]Intimia was actually killed during a massive attack by Darkritters.[/spoiler]
